name: Short 4 - paper_mill
script: Nokia started in Finland in 1865 as a paper mill. Over the next century it made rubber boots, cables, and electronics. Then in the nineteen nineties, it bet everything on mobile phones. By 1998 it was the largest phone maker in the world. And it held that position for fourteen years. Which means the company everyone calls a tech failure was actually a hundred and thirty year old survivor that won for longer than most companies even exist.
